name: Renewal generated under RLM Quote DML lock (initiateRenewal headless, no Apex Quote DML)
what_it_tests: With RLM/Subscription Mgmt enabled, all Quote DML is platform-blocked; renewal QLI creation and COLA/description seeding must occur via the platform initiateRenewal API or event/trigger paths, NOT Apex Quote DML, or the seed silently fails; verifies the Quote-DML-lock constraint on the renewal seed path (F-04 covers prehook bypass but not the DML-lock root)
proc_mechanism: RLM Quote DML lock (Apex==REST error); Fortra_Create_Renewal_Quote uses initiateRenewal; COLA/description must be applied via Reprice-All-triggered prehook or post-create platform-event flow, not Apex update on QuoteLineItem
expected_behavior: Renewal QLIs seeded with COLA + description without any Apex Quote DML; if a class attempts Quote DML it must be refactored to event/flow; no silent lock-swallow
test_setup: Generate renewal headlessly with RLM enabled, confirm COLA + description applied without Apex Quote update; attempt Apex Quote DML expects platform block

prior_run.actual: Empirical probe on FortraUAT (Savepoint+rollback, no persistence): Apex 'update QuoteLineItem' = QLI_UPDATE_SUCCEEDED; Apex 'update Quote' (allOrNone=true) = QUOTE_UPDATE_SUCCEEDED; Database.update(Quote, allOrNone=false) = SOFT_QUOTE_UPDATE_SUCCEEDED. The premise that all Quote DML is platform-blocked is REFUTED in this org. The actual seed path is lock-immune by design: COLAUpliftPrehook.buildLineItemUpdates returns context-update payloads (List<Map>) consumed by the pricing-engine write-back, NOT Apex QLI DML; QLDescriptionGeneratorPrehook likewise emits context-update payloads; the only Apex DML in the seed path are RenewalAssetQuantityHandler L139/142 (update QuoteAction + update QuoteLineItem, allOrNone=true, in a Queueable) and COLAUpliftPrehook.MyCAPFlagApplier L1397 (Database.update Quote.Mycap__c, allOrNone=false) — and BOTH DML targets are proven WRITABLE, so no silent lock-sw…

The seed architecture is correctly lock-immune regardless: COLA/description seed via pricing-engine context-write payloads, not Apex QLI DML, so there is no silent-lock-swallow surface to fail.
